# MobileNetworkSlicingWithLLM

> Two-tier control plane for 6G network slicing: fast ML (forecaster + KPI predictor) plus an analytic capacity model in Tier 1; an LLM (Ollama cloud: glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.3, deepseek-v4-pro, mistral-large-4) acting through typed MCP tools in Tier 2; a verification gate; and an offline hindsight oracle that scores decisions. Research prototype for a master's thesis on wireless networks — evaluates whether an LLM can turn ML signals + KPIs + cluster state into correct, safe per-slice replica decisions.

This is a simulation, not a live system. There is no real Kubernetes cluster and no real KPI telemetry: delay/loss/violation are always recomputed from the analytic capacity model, and the dataset supplies only the per-slice load. The LLM's accuracy comes from the MCP tools (`inspect_infrastructure` exposes required replicas, headroom, utilization), not from the model itself or from prompt wording. Core code is numpy + stdlib only; notebooks and PDFs use a `.venv` with jupyter/pandas/matplotlib/reportlab.
